headline: GENTLEMEN 🍿 STARS 🧑‍🎤 STAY TIGHT-LIPPED 😶 On MEGHAN 👑 Rumours 🗣️
text:
It's been TWO 🕒 WEEKS 📅 since those JUICY 💦 reports DROPPED 📉 claiming the DUCHESS 👑 of SUSSEX was in EARLY 🌱 talks for a ROLE 🎭 in THE GENTLEMEN 🍸!! At the WORLD 🌍 PREMIERE 🎉 for series TWO 2️⃣ on Wednesday 🌙 night the STARS ⭐ including MAYA 🌴 JAMA HUGH 🏰 BONNEVILLE and THEO 🧔 JAMES all played it COY 🦊 refusing to SPILL 🥛 any TEA 🍵 about MEGHAN possibly JOINING the CAST 🎬!! "It's FASCINATING 🔍 to WATCH 👀 but ultimately it's a LOT of RUMOUR 🐂" James told BBC while JAMA straight up said "I'd be the LAST 🏁 person to KNOW 🤷‍♀️!" bro these celebs are EDGING 📈 us so HARD 🍆 with the TEASE 😩!!

The show's EXECUTIVE 💼 PRODUCER straight up REFUSED 🙅 to say YES 👍 or NO ❌ to the MEGHAN reports but he did tease they're cooking up "MORE ENERGY ⚡ and SURPRISES 🎁" for the fans so NOT a NO then huh 😏!! THE GENTLEMEN 🕴️ a wild COMEDY 😂 ACTION 💥 series about a DUKE turning DRUG BARON 💊 created by GUY RITCHIE dropped as a MAJOR HIT 📈 in 2024 and has now been OFFICIALLY 🟢 greenlit for a THIRD 3️⃣ series with MEGHAN talks still in the SUPER early STAGES 🍼!! Ray WINSTONE Theo JAMES Kaya and the whole CREW posed for pics at the premiere while the DRIZZLE 🌧️ cleared up at GUILDHALL 🏛️ with VINNIE 💪 JONES Joely and more showing up to the CARPET 🧶!!

When grilled about the MEGHAN buzz VINNIE JONES admitted he's heard "ONLY what YOU have" but then dropped a cheeky JOKE 😂 saying "We've got a LOT of PRETTY women in this series so I'm not sure there's ROOM 🛏️ for any MORE" implying the cast is already STACKED 🍑 like that one UNC down BAD for the ladies!! KAYA said it's "WAY above my PAY GRADE 💰" while BONNEVILLE claimed he had "NO IDEA 🤷" if the rumours held any TRUTH 🔮 yet THEO JAMES couldn't resist declaring "Prince HARRY is in it he's playing one of my LOVE INTERESTS 💘" which has everyone GIGGLING 🤭 at the INNUENDO!!

MAYA JAMA as the FRESH 🆕 newcomer to the cast said she had ZERO tips for MEGHAN adding "Oh my GOD she’s a SEASONED actor I have NO advice for her she knows what she’s DOING 💪" which is basically her politely saying back OFF 📴 while the EXEC producer MATTHEW READ told BBC they're looking forward to "bringing up MORE energy and SURPRISES in series two and further ON" in the show!! When pressed if that was code for yes he backed off saying "I just don't think it's RIGHT to SPECULATE at this stage so I wouldn't like to say YES or NO" leaving us all BLUE 🥶 BALLED from the lack of CONFIRMATION 🍆!!

In the FIRST series EDDIE HALSTEAD played by THEO inherits the family ESTATE 🏡 after dad's DEATH ☠️ pissing off his brother FREDDY only to discover it's secretly growing CANNABIS 🌿 for a massive underground DRUG EMPIRE 💼!! Now in series TWO the criminal enterprise is EXPANDING 🌍 out of the British countryside and straight into the LUSH lakeside vibes of ITALY 🇮🇹 with THEO saying "If you're going to do it you've got to make sure it's BETTER" so they worked extra HARD to evolve the WORLD 🌐 with more COMPLEX plots and deeper CHARACTER development that left the cast absolutely DRAINED 🥴 yet satisfied 😌!!

SCODELARIO who plays the TOUGH as NAILS SUSIE GLASS running the CANNABIS farm echoed that they "really tried to RAISE the STAKES as much as possible" with some episodes taking a much DARKER turn but still keeping the FUN and JOY that hooked everyone last time!! BONNEVILLE the DOWNTON ABBEY vet called working with RITCHIE "wonderfully CHAOTIC but with a great PURPOSE" joking there's literally NO difference between period DRAMA and the criminal UNDERWORLD because "it was exactly the same WORLD" of perverted ARISTOCRACY up to no GOOD 🍑 before adding he's sure the same freaky stuff was happening at DOWNTON but now the LID is LIFTED on these stately HOMES 🏠!! Series TWO drops on NETFLIX on 3 SEPTEMBER so stay tuned for whatever MEGHAN shaped SURPRISE might be coming 😈!!
